articles.title: Maryland Women's Business Center Recognized as 2026 National WBC of Excellence
articles.mainIdea: Maryland Women's Business Center Recognized as 2026 National WBC of Excellence
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Maryland Women's Business Center Recognized as 2026 National WBC of Excellence. The Maryland Women's Business Center (MWBC) is honored to be recognized for graduating in the 2026 cohort with the National WBC of Excellence program offered by the Association of Women's Business Centers (AWBC). This marks the second consecutive year MWBC has earned the National WBC of Excellence designation.

articles.title: Paradise Introduces "Paradise Pleasure Products": Illumination Series, The World's First RGB LED Pleasure Product Line
articles.mainIdea: Paradise Introduces "Paradise Pleasure Products": Illumination Series, The World's First RGB LED Pleasure Product Line
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Paradise Introduces "Paradise Pleasure Products": Illumination Series, The World's First RGB LED Pleasure Product Line. Paradise Marketing, a premier distributor in the Sexual Health and Wellness segment, unveiled today Paradise Pleasure Products and the Illumination Series product line, the world's first and only RGB LED enhanced adult toy line, adding a new realm of visual excitement coined Body Illumination. Pre-orders for the new Illumination Series start today, with shipping expected to begin mid-January 2026.
